title: Gordon Cooper's saucer-shaped craft flying in formation

tellings.quote: >> Well, it turns out they didn't have wings. They were saucer shape.

plain: The American pilot and astronaut Gordon Cooper says that in the 1950s he saw a group of craft flying in formation that, on a closer look, had no wings and were saucer shaped. He tells it as something he saw himself: "it turns out they didn't have wings. They were saucer shape." Coming from a trained pilot, it is offered as a sighting that ordinary aircraft cannot explain.
